tooltips.name: Lead form display name (synced from Meta or admin-edited).
tooltips.formId: Meta numeric leadgen form id. Used to route incoming webhook events to this row.
tooltips.funnel: Funnel where Opportunities will be created for leads from this form. Required when isActive=true; sync may create rows without it set.
tooltips.opportunityStage: OpportunityStage to use for created Opportunities. Empty = first active stage of the funnel.
tooltips.assignedUser: Default assignedUser for created Contacts/Opportunities. Empty = unassigned.
tooltips.isActive: Inactive forms are skipped at ingestion (event marked status=skipped).
tooltips.createOpportunity: When true, each lead creates an Opportunity linked to the Contact in the configured Funnel.
tooltips.fieldMapping: Per-form override map: {metaFieldName: contactAttribute}. Merged on top of built-in defaults (email, full_name, first_name, last_name, phone_number, phone, city, company_name).
